newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists see more upside in AEX.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Dutch chartists see more upside in AEX.

text.p: Dutch chartists broadly agreed on the positive prospects for the AEX index of 25 leading Dutch shares in the near future. Despite the index's substantial rise last week, they see room for further improvement.
The AEX index ended at 670.08 points on Friday, 23.39 points above the previous Friday. In the previous week, the index had gained 0.74 points.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ABN AMRO - Positive signs are being confirmed by increasing volumes. There is an expectation of decreasing volatility in the market. We advise re-entering the long side of the market. After a possible test of 668 to search for support, we expect the index to force its way up through 676 resistance. The next target is the psychological resistance level of 700. The medium term target lies around 720. In our view, the index has succeeded in finding clear direction in the medium term.

ING Barings - Already very bullish technicals have further improved; the market's rising trend channel has been breached on the upside. As new investors jump on the bandwagon and click funds support prices, the present six-week uptrend has started an acceleration. The underlying inflow of new funds is confirmed by extremely positive money flow indicators. The advance/decline ratio, measuring the market breadth of the AEX, also remains very strong. All in all, the internal technicals of the AEX remain positive.
IRIS - The AEX broke above rising resistance last week and triggered a strong buy signal again. Apart from small setbacks, we expect a further rise for the AEX index.
